_comment: The Expanse — MCRN, EARLY/CLASSIC look (the Tachi / Donnager, Syfy era S1-3). Split from `roci` (late/Amazon smooth-blue). Grounded in refs/tachi/NOTES.md (Donnager NqDcnwrsq6U): dark INDUSTRIAL GREY hull + RED as a CO-PRIMARY working color (red concentric tactical plots, not just danger) + steel-cyan secondary; grittier/harder/less-glow than roci. Reuses roci's machinery (layout=cockpit, chrome=instrument; D-DIN type). CAVEAT: tachi=grey+red / roci=blue is a curatorial conceit, not literal canon (rename was S1; palette drift was the S4 handoff). See memory roci_tachi_era_split. v1 = palette+layout+chrome; skin/furniture/composition + Gemini critique loop are the refine pass.

data._comment: RED-forward + steel-cyan ladder — the classic-MCRN duotone (red is a co-primary here, NOT just the rare-signal slot like roci). System amber[4]/danger-red[5] stay status signals.
